title: Shared definitions for Lefi Crop MQTT v1

device_id.description: Assigned by Lefi Brain when the device is added (e.g. esp32-01). The sim- prefix marks a simulated device.

sensor_key.description: Fixed channel key from the node profile (packages/contracts/hardware). Sensor id in Lefi Brain = {device_id}:{sensor_key}.

origin.description: ADR-012. Real firmware always sends LIVE; the simulator always SIMULATED.

boot_id.description: Random hex created at each boot (ADR-008).
